items.title: Anthropic Owes $71 Billion for Compute Within a Year, “87% of Current Run Rate Revenue,” per Scott Galloway
items.summary: Key TakeawaysScott Galloway says $71 billion of Anthropic’s compute commitments come due within a year, a bill that reaches Amazon, Alphabet and Broadcom. With over $200 billion of cash after its IPO, Anthropic can pay it, so the bigger worry is its slowing revenue growth.

items.title: Jim Cramer: Amazon Could Sell Its Anthropic Stake and Say “Our CapEx Is Paid For.” Does the Math Work?
